{{Top|leg}}
'''Repulsor columns''' were large pieces of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] technology used by the [[Viska (species)|Viska]] to keep their structures aloft. The columns were over five hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long and one hundred meters in diameter.<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>
